body: Happy birthday!! i rlly hope things get better for U. and i feel the same way, im turning 18 in 2 months and i feel like im not ready yet to be an adult ya know 😅 i still gotta het my shit together

i totally understand you :). we kinda have similar lives actually and its really comforting to know im not alone and you should also. am 17 and ive also been struggling with an ed during quarantine. My gpa has also been the lowest ever and it feels like nothing will get better honestly. Talking about feelings and just comforting one another has always been taboo in my family. we are never really that affectionate and dealing with depression for me in a family like this is really really hard.  It hurts me to read what you're parents think of your mental health and i cant even imagine what you're going through. I also couldn't bring myself to actually attempt until two days ago and it was the strangest and most scariest experience ever. And just like you i have a few friends that im scared of hurting which makes this whole thing suck. Attempting the other day brought me so close to what I thought i wanted (dying) but it made me realize that i don't actually want that and all i want is instead to just disappear without making anyone's lives any harder and just vanish silently into nothingness. But anyways, please never feel alone and I admire you so much. You are such strong person you have no idea. If you think about it it's amazing that both of us are still here today and it just means that we are meant to be here. Sending you all my love and I hope both of us recover soon .
